cleavage agent: Samples were analyzed on a Q-Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) after trypsin digestion.
enrichment method: Nxf3 proteins were immunoprecipitated by incubation with 40 µL of Nxf3 antibody overnight at 4°C.
instrument: Samples were analyzed on a Q-Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Precursor abundance was quantified based on intensity
precursor tolerance: MS1 mass tolerance was constrained to 20 ppm
fragment tolerance: the fragment ion mass tolerance was set to 0.02 Da.
ptm: Oxidation of methionine residues (+15.995 KDa); deamidation (+0.984) of asparagine and glutamine residues
Oxidation of methionine residues (+15.995 KDa) AND deamidation (+0.984) of asparagine and glutamine residues were included as dynamic modifications.
